newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Elan says gets FDA approval for drug.
newsitem.headline: Elan says gets FDA approval for drug.

text.p: Irish pharmaceutical group Elan Corporation Plc said on Monday that it had received approval from an advisory committee of the U.S. Foods and Drug Administration (FDA) for a drug to be used in the treatment of severe epilepsy.
Approval was sought by Elan's wholly-owned subsidiary, Athena Neurosciences, in December 1995 for a New Drug Application (NDA) for a drug called Diastat (diazepam rectal gel).
Diatstat is a gel formulation designed for home use in the treatment of a severe epilepsy condition previously defined as acute repetitive seizures, Elan said in a statement.

The statement said the FDA body, the Peripheral and Central Nervous System Drugs Advisory Committee, unanimously recommended approval of the new drug application and it recommended that certain aspects of this epilepsy condition be taken into account in arriving at the product's final labelling.
